name: playwright-suite-and-gap-specs
approach: Ran existing 13 Playwright specs against production. Categorised failures: 4 root-cause groups, fixed 3 in-phase, 4th deferred with writeup.

results.initial_run: 84 passed / 26 skipped / 28 failed across mobile + desktop
results.after_phase_2_fixes: predicted ~92 passed / 26 skipped / ~20 failed (gap-year combobox + visual regression remain)

real_defects_fixed.title: 16 pages had `| NakshIQ | NakshIQ` stutter in <title>
real_defects_fixed.where: guide/{permits,sim-card,food-safety,scams,visa,transport-overview,currency,etiquette,packing,book-indian-trains}, where-to-go, the-window, weekend-from, gap-year, gap-year/[token], arrival
real_defects_fixed.root_cause: Each page hardcoded ` | NakshIQ` in metadata.title. Layout's title.template = `%s | NakshIQ` then appended another suffix.
real_defects_fixed.evidence: before fix: `<title>India Permits Guide — ILP, PAP, RAP state by state | NakshIQ | NakshIQ</title>` ; after: clean single suffix
real_defects_fixed.impact: SEO — duplicated brand truncates important keywords in SERP, dilutes click signal

real_defects_fixed.title: Hardcoded `491 destinations` on Trip Board cold-start while /explore reads live DB count
real_defects_fixed.fix: {destinations.length} interpolation; 491 was stale post pilgrimage-circuits expansion

real_defects_fixed.title: PWA icon-192.png 404 via R2 image-loader
real_defects_fixed.where: lib/image-loader.ts unconditionally rewrote root pngs to /icon-192-w400.webp variants that don't exist on R2
real_defects_fixed.fix: Skip variant rewrite for paths without subdirectory; root assets fall through to original key

stale_test_assertions_fixed.title: homepage.spec.ts expected `Explore by region` but copy was shortened to `By region`
stale_test_assertions_fixed.fix: Drop text-match; assert structural region-card count >= 6

stale_test_assertions_fixed.title: where-to-go.spec.ts expected /en/where-to-go to 307 to current month — page is now a standalone hub by intent
stale_test_assertions_fixed.fix: Test now asserts hub page renders with >= 12 month links

stale_test_assertions_fixed.title: trip-board.spec.ts × 6 — markers `[data-yearband]` / `[data-cost-aggregate]` / `[data-trip-map]` only render in advanced ThreePane view but tests didn't seed view-mode
stale_test_assertions_fixed.fix: Add localStorage.setItem('nq-trip-mode','advanced') to beforeEach in 3 describe blocks

stale_test_assertions_fixed.title: ALL specs that hover/click navs were intercepted by guided-tour overlay
stale_test_assertions_fixed.where: playwright.config.ts storageState — only seeded quizSeen + pwa-install-dismissed, not the tour flag

deferred_with_writeup.title: gap-year origin combobox: typing 'Rajas' should surface Jaipur (state: Rajasthan)
deferred_with_writeup.status: REPRODUCED — likely client hydration timing on the dropdown rather than findCity scoring (verified scoring is correct in lib/gap-year/origin-cities.ts)

deferred_with_writeup.next_step: Inventory hardcoded strings, add to messages/en.json + hi.json with next-intl t() calls

tests/e2e/_deep/hindi-parity.spec.ts — would currently fail on the known A1/B1 i18n gaps; redundant with manual i18n inventory above

additional_findings_logged_for_user: Multiple non-test pages hardcode `491 destinations` (layout.tsx metadata, guide/first-trip-india, cost-index, methodology/freshness). Marketing copy treated as low-priority for this run; could be unified through getAppStats().
stats.ts FALLBACK has destinations:505 but live DB query returns 491 — fallback is a stale post-expansion estimate. Update FALLBACK to 491 OR rely on the live count and let unstable_cache hold it.
